source: TESTING.md §7.3 'accrued on a coupon date and the day before', coupon-date half: settling on 2026-08-15, the coupon date itself, puts settlement at the start of the next accrual period, so accrued is exactly 0 and the first cashflow is a whole period away (firstPeriodFraction = 1). Exact, hence tolerance 0.

TESTING.md §7.3 'accrued on a coupon date and the day before', day-before half, on the ACT/ACT ICMA convention of TESTING §7.4. Coupon period 2026-02-15 -> 2026-08-15 is 181 actual days; settlement 2026-08-14 is 180 days in. accrued = 100 x 0.0425 x 180/(181 x 2) = 4.25 x 180/362 = 2.113259668508287 - the whole 2.125 coupon less one day of it (2.125 x 180/181). Closed form, tolerance 1e-12.
